notes.title: Achievements enabled + small bug fixes
notes.content:
version 151107:

- Added Steam support and 21 achievements. CGs and endings related achievements should automatically unlock at first boot, the others have to be unlocked manually. However, every achievement unlocked offline from this version will be granted at boot if connected to Steam.
  
- Fixed a typo in the Japanese version.

- The movies were re-encoded at a lower FPS. This should fix the problem someone had playing movies while using the hardware rendering.
